---
title: 'Approve a build'
status: implemented
description: 'Release a build that waits at the approval step, or reject it.'
---

When a pipeline's approval policy covers a build, Oore queues it but no runner
claims it until a project maintainer decides. See
[Triggers, timeouts and approvals](/build/pipelines/triggers) to set the
policy.

## What you need

- Project maintainer, instance admin, or instance owner access.
- A build that shows **Awaiting approval**.

Notification channels that subscribe to `build_approval_needed` announce each
build that starts waiting.

## 1. Open the build

Open the build from the notification, **Builds**, or the project's build list.

## 2. Decide

Select **Approve** to release the build to the runner queue, or **Reject** to
cancel it. You can add a note; it appears on the build timeline and in the
audit log.

The same decisions are available through
[Approve build](/openapi/operations/approve_build) and
[Reject build](/openapi/operations/reject_build).

## Verify the result

An approved build stays `queued` until a runner claims it, then runs as usual.
A rejected build is `canceled`. The build timeline records who decided, and
the audit log records `build_approved` or `build_rejected`.

## Troubleshooting

**Approve and Reject are missing**

Only maintainers can decide. Developers can still cancel the build.

**Oore says the build is not waiting for approval**

Someone else already decided, or the build was canceled.

## Next step

[Cancel a build](/build/run/cancel) that should not run, or change which
builds need approval in [Triggers, timeouts and approvals](/build/pipelines/triggers#approval).
